byog.admin.multiplier_high_tps_desc: Bonus awarded to worker nodes delivering sustained throughput exceeding 40 Tokens Per Second.
byog.admin.multiplier_sub_second_ttft_de: Incentive granted when Time To First Token is under 1.0 second for ultra-responsive streaming.
byog.admin.multiplier_high_uptime_desc: Reward for nodes maintaining continuous network availability for 7 or more consecutive days.
byog.admin.multiplier_super_uptime_desc: Top-tier reliability bonus for nodes connected without interruption for 30 or more days.
byog.admin.multiplier_residential_ip_des: Boost applied to residential broadband nodes to broaden geographical decentralization and anti-datacenter diversity.
byog.admin.multiplier_gigabit_fiber_desc: Bonus for high-bandwidth nodes with >= 1000 Mbps download and >= 500 Mbps upload speeds.
byog.admin.multiplier_low_latency_desc: Reward for low latency edge nodes with ping times strictly below 30ms.
byog.admin.multiplier_clean_reputation_d: Bonus awarded to nodes maintaining a flawless 100/100 reputation score without failed audits.
byog.admin.multiplier_low_temp_desc: Efficiency incentive for nodes operating at safe, cool thermal thresholds under compute load.
byog.admin.multiplier_battery_eco_desc: Safety multiplier for mobile and tablet nodes running while plugged in with battery temps below 38°C.
byog.admin.multiplier_night_owl_desc: Dynamic surge multiplier active during off-peak night hours (01:00 - 08:00).
byog.admin.multiplier_weekend_crunch_des: Surge multiplier active throughout weekends to support peak compute loads.
